suitableFor: top-of-page section intros with a large photographic background and overlaid heading + one-line description
landing/listing page mastheads without a call-to-action
light, minimal hero areas where text sits in a white card over the image
notSuitableFor: dark full-bleed promotional banners with a CTA (use hero-banner)

breakdown.purpose: mismatch (mid-page promo banner+CTA vs top-of-page intro, no CTA) -> 0
breakdown.structure: partial (background image + heading + description overlap; hero-banner adds a CTA) -> +0.10

similarityEvaluation.reason: Below 80% threshold vs hero-banner: different color scheme (light card vs dark overlay), different purpose (calm top-of-page intro vs high-impact mid-page promo), and no CTA. Warrants a distinct variant.

usage.notes: Adventures intro: full-bleed bushland/river image with a white card containing 'Experience the world with us' + one-line description. No CTA.
